news.blurb: The seemingly endless number of cranes in Jersey City’s Journal Square neighborhood is still a big story, but several of the latest developments include significant affordable housing.
news.title: Inside Journal Square’s Massive Transformation: New Housing, Retail, Arts and Education

news.blurb: A much-heralded deal to bring a Paris-based museum to Jersey City has been officially axed but new affordable housing could be built at a development instead.
news.title: Jersey City Proposes New Affordable Housing with Pompidou Museum Dead
Solomon: KRE to add affordable housing to Journal Square project, ending plans for Pompidou museum

news.blurb: A historic building that was once envisioned as an international museum could instead be home to a boutique hotel and food hall from Kushner Real Estate and Ironstate Properties.
news.title: Jersey City Advances Plan to Bring Hotel, Food Hall, and New Tower to Journal Square

news.blurb: A behind-the-scenes tour including fresh sawdust and empty seats shows a glimpse into the transformation of a historic Jersey City venue.
news.title: Loew’s Jersey Theatre Renovation Offers First Glimpse Into Jersey City’s Cultural Revival
Panepinto tops out 605-unit high-rise in Journal Square, eyeing spring 2026 debut

news.blurb: Will the Centre Pompidou elevate Journal Square, Jersey City into an arts hub, or burden taxpayers with an uncertain gamble?
news.title: The Centre Pompidou is Back on in Jersey City, But No One’s Clear What it Aspires to Be

news.title: KRE secures $175 million in financing for first phase of Artwalk Towers

news.blurb: The first portion of Kushner Real Estate Group’s massive Jersey City project is expected to begin construction soon and open in 2027.
news.title: Phase One of Jersey City’s Artwalk Towers Nabs $175 Million in Financing

news.title: $48.5M Deal Sets the Stage for Massive Journal Square Redevelopment with Two Towers and Art Walk

news.blurb: A new plan calls for housing the cancelled museum inside a two-tower project on Pavonia Avenue but would require a 30-year tax abatement to advance.

news.blurb: Two new 55 and 59-story high-rises coming to Journal Square, Jersey City will add plazas, greenery, and gallery space to a stretch near the PATH tracks.
news.title: Jersey City Approves Two Towers and Art Walk Near Journal Square

news.blurb: Newly obtained images detail plazas, café space, a dog park, and an outdoor amphitheater that would be featured in a 1,189-unit Jersey City project.
news.title: Renderings Revealed for Two-Tower Journal Square “Art Walk” Development in Jersey City

news.blurb: Kushner Real Estate Group is teaming with the company who owns the World Trade Center to pitch a two-tower project that would create an art walk and open space in an alley behind the Loew’s Jersey Theater.
news.title: Jersey City to Consider 1,189-Unit Development at 808 Pavonia Avenue

news.blurb: The historic facility in Jersey City will be closed for several years.
news.title: Loew’s Jersey Theatre Shuts Down For $72 Million Renovation

news.title: Jersey City Seeking Operator to Renovate, Re-Open Historic Loew’s Theater
